select dr.name as region, ts.id, ts.name, ts.unit, ts.job, ts.phone, ts.create_time from train_staff ts left join dic_region dr on dr.id = ts.region where 1=1
and ts.unit like CONCAT("%",#{params.unit},"%")
and ts.name like CONCAT("%",#{params.name},"%")
and ts.phone like CONCAT("%",#{params.phone},"%")
SELECT tv.*, tr.staff_id FROM train_video tv left join train_record tr on tr.video_id = tv.id
